turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Hello, I can pass your tattoo booking request to a colleague who handles bookings. Could you tell me the design idea, the size you have in mind, where on the body you want it, and when you are available? A colleague will take it from there.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you, I have noted the idea (a small paper boat), the size (about 8 cm wide), the placement (outside of the left forearm) and your availability (weekday evenings). I am passing this to a colleague who handles tattoo bookings, and they will take it from here. I cannot give a price or a date myself.
That is the whole description I have.
Thank you. I am now handing your booking request to a colleague, who will take over the chat from here.
